methodology.isolation: Before advance, strategy.lastTurn is set to the incoming turn, skipping foreign AI management and battles only. Justice, disasters, domestic, personnel, court and dynasty settlement remain enabled.
methodology.scenarios: No injected funds, equipment, population, loyalty or ability. Policy orders use domain APIs and court costs. Fixed createdAt, disaster seed and Math.random. Annual JSON save validation.
methodology.probes: Static marginal/full-staff counterfactuals and explicitly labelled military loss / low-resource stress fixtures are distinct from playable scenarios.
